item.title: Week 10: Rams at Cardinals
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 4:05 PM ET | Line: LA -9.5 · O/U 38.5 | Model ARI 22% vs. market 19% | On paper the Rams have the edge (The Rams' defense ranks 9th in explosive play rate, 8.2% allowed). Under center, Matthew Stafford ranks 15th of 31 in EPA per dropback; x-factor: Puka Nacua gets 31% of the Rams' targets and 32% of its air yards, and Arizona's pass defense ranks 29th. The model favors the Rams at 78%, mostly on rushing matchup (4.6 pts) and passing matchup (4.0 pts).
